hero.title: The Government
hero.subtitle: Government of the Republic of Astoria
hero.intro: The Government is the executive organisation responsible for carrying out government action. It acts under the direction and coordination of the President of the Republic, Head of State, who exercises executive power. This page explains what the Government is, how it is organised and how it carries out its action.

understand.title: What is the Government?
understand.lead: The Government steers the Nation's policy and coordinates public action. It is neither a person nor a simple list of ministers: it is the executive organisation bringing together the ministers responsible for public policies.

executive.title: Part of the executive branch
executive.text: The President of the Republic and the Government form the executive branch. The Government is the organisation that prepares and carries out the Nation's policy.

direction.title: Led by the President of the Republic
direction.text: The President of the Republic is the Head of State: they exercise executive power and direct and coordinate the Government, which acts under their authority.

membres.title: Made up of ministers
membres.text: Ministers are the members of the Government. Each one is responsible for a ministry and for the public policies within its area of responsibility.

administrations.title: Backed by administrations
administrations.text: To act, the Government relies on ministries, secretariats of state and public administrations, which carry out public policies and deliver public services.

executive.title: The President of the Republic at the centre of the executive branch
executive.lead: Under the Astorian constitutional model, the President of the Republic is the Head of State and exercises executive power. The President directs and coordinates the Government: the head of the executive gives government action its direction.
executive.intro: The diagram below presents the organisation of the Astorian executive branch. The President is not one government member among others: they are its leader and coordinator. The roles are described institutionally, without reference to office holders.
executive.ariaLabel: Diagram of the executive branch organisation: the President of the Republic directs and coordinates the Government, which relies on ministries, secretariats of state and public administrations.

hero.title: Constitution of the Republic of Astoria
hero.lead: The foundational text of the Republic
hero.intro: The Constitution is the supreme legal text of the Republic of Astoria. It defines the fundamental principles of the Republic, the organisation of public authorities, constitutionally recognised rights and obligations, and the relations between the institutions of the State.

tableOfContents.title: Contents of the Constitution
tableOfContents.lead: Structure of the constitutional text. Each title and each article is directly accessible.

related.title: Understanding the Constitution
related.lead: The Constitution defines the institutional framework of the Republic. To learn more about the institutions it organises:

organisation.title: Organisation of the Republic
organisation.description: Discover how the State, the institutions and the public authorities of the Republic of Astoria are organised.

hero.title: Organisation of the Republic
hero.subtitle: Understanding how the State and institutions of the Republic of Astoria are organised.
hero.intro: The Republic of Astoria relies on an institutional organisation that defines the main components of the State, distributes competences between institutions and organises the functioning of public authorities. This page presents an overview of this organisation.

overview.title: The organisation of the State
overview.lead: The institutional structure of the Republic is built around fundamental principles and components organised by the Constitution.
overview.note: The components presented below reflect the institutional model as defined by the official sources of the project.

institutions.title: The main institutions
institutions.lead: The institutions of the Republic exercise constitutional functions and ensure the functioning of the State.

constitution.title: The Constitution
constitution.text: The Constitution is the foundational text that defines the organisation of public authorities, citizens' rights and obligations, and the institutional framework of the Republic.

president.title: The President of the Republic
president.text: Head of State, the President exercises executive power and ensures the direction and coordination of the Government. He is the central institution of the executive.

government.title: The Government
government.text: The executive organisation responsible for implementing government action. The Government acts under the direction of the President of the Republic.

governmentSection.title: The Government in the organisation of the State
governmentSection.lead: The Government is the executive body responsible for conducting government action within the framework defined by the Constitution and the laws.
governmentSection.intro: The President of the Republic is the Head of State: he exercises executive power, ensures the direction and coordination of the Government. The Government conducts the policy of the Nation and coordinates public action, relying on the ministries and administrations.

levels.title: From institution to administration
levels.lead: The organisation of the State comprises several levels, from fundamental institutions to the services that ensure daily functioning.

government.title: The Government
government.text: The executive organisation that brings together the ministers and conducts government action.

ministry.title: A ministry
ministry.text: The department of the State responsible for an area of competence. It exists independently of its holder.

administration.title: An administration
administration.text: The services that implement public policies on a daily basis and provide public services.

relations.title: How institutions work together
relations.lead: The components of the State work within an institutional framework defined by the Constitution.

constitution.title: The Constitution
constitution.text: Defines the institutional framework and the distribution of competences.

government.title: The Government
government.text: Conducts executive action and implements public policies.

ministries.title: The ministries
ministries.text: Structure governmental domains and coordinate public action.

administrations.title: The administrations
administrations.text: Implement decisions and provide daily public services.
